programs.title: Built on Sand and Sea: Dunhuang and Venice Ep.3
programs.desc: This documentary features Dunhuang and Venice as dual protagonists against the epic backdrop of the Silk Road. Through their founding stories, commercial networks, artistic traditions, and heritage preservation efforts, it reveals how these cities became stages where humanity created material and spiritual civilizations amid desert sands and ocean waves—and where diverse cultures collided, fused, and ultimately flourished.

programs.title: China Bound: Harbin
programs.desc: Tianran He is in Harbin, the "Ice City", host of the 2025 Asian Winter Games. Internationally renowned for its breathtaking ice and snow sculptures, the city thrives with activity despite it -20°C winters. From savoring the famous local ice cream and hearty northeastern Chinese dishes such as stewed goose and sweet-and-sour pork, to drifting on the frozen Songhua River and carving down the slopse of Yabuli Ski Resort, discover how much fun you can have in Harbin.

programs.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programs.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.
